public_data_only.rationale: Source is Florida DBPR (Department of Business and Professional Regulation) weekly CSV at https://www2.myfloridalicense.com/real-estate-commission/public-records/ — mandated public disclosure under Florida Public Records Act (F.S. Ch. 119). No authentication required, no login bypass, no scraped-behind-login data. Direct file download at https://www2.myfloridalicense.com/sto/file_download/extracts/REALESTATE2501LICENSE_1.csv.

no_pii_in_delivered_csv.rationale: Data steward identified and stripped 16 rows (14 phone numbers, 2 personal email addresses embedded in 'street' or 'zip' source fields). Independent full-column PII sweep across all 448,610 rows of the cleaned CSV confirms zero residual email addresses, phone numbers, or SSNs in any field (license_code, licensee_name, dba_name, rank, street, city, state, zip, county). All 16 originally-flagged license numbers individually verified clean.

source_url_on_every_row.rationale: All 448,610 data rows carry a non-empty source_url pointing to the DBPR CSV download. Zero rows missing.

commercial_resale_rights.rationale: Florida DBPR license records are government-mandated public records under Florida Public Records Act (F.S. Ch. 119). Government agency public records are not subject to copyright (17 U.S.C. § 105 by analogy; Florida courts hold the same for state records). No terms of service restrict commercial redistribution of the DBPR public records export. Confirmed commercial market: at least three vendors (RealEstateAgentData.com, BookYourData, USAgentLeads) currently sell formatted versions of the identical dataset at $39–$499+ price points.

data_quality_warnings.note: The following are non-blocking quality flags from the steward's validation pass. They do not affect the compliance verdict.

warnings.detail: 3,278 null issue dates; 6 rows parse as future dates due to DD-MON-YY 2-digit year ambiguity (likely pre-1969 licenses). Source data quality artifact.
116 rows missing one or more address fields (international/out-of-state licensees); 9,490 rows with null county (foreign addresses). Source data reflects real-world address variation.
1 license with 'BL' prefix (BL268126, Broker Associate) — likely source data entry error. Retained as-is; not a compliance issue.
Same 1 row as above (BL268126). Mismatch is a source artifact.

pii_stripped_rows.note: Counts overlap — 15 rows affected in 'street', 1 in 'zip', total 16 distinct rows.
